title: Registry: chaos process-kill an app node (RR pair tolerates one)
description: Runs `nexus chaos registry process-kill --target registry-2 --duration 30 --yes`. Process-kills docker on an app node (the Harbor compose stack drops there); the round-robin DNS pair keeps serving from registry-1 + the datastore/VIP stay up; the adapter restarts docker + `docker compose up -d` and polls Harbor health back to healthy.

observe.what: observed-impact during the kill shows harbor-app 1/2 healthy (registry-2 down) while pg/redis/s3/VIP stay green; then cluster recovered = true

whatProves: RegistryAdapter.ApplyChaosAsync runs the embedded nexus-chaos.sh (process-kill = docker on an app node), then recovers via docker restart + compose up + a Harbor health poll; the VRRP VIP holder is spared (refused as a target).
